object.attr: stakeholder: a git client can change line endings, and a hand-edited file can be re-indented, without changing a requirement. Widened to canonical forms with the person on 2026-11-07, so a change in how files are written, such as the quote style, marks no object Modified.
object.description: When Mellon compares two versions of a document, Mellon shall count as no change a difference between a file at From and at To that is gone in the file's canonical form.
